title: Finite type algebras have regular prime-local completion maps
statement: Let R be a G-ring and S a finite type R-algebra. For every prime p of S, the completion map S_p -> (S_p)^ is regular.

source.place: More on Algebra, Proposition 07PV, proof of Tag 07PV, reduction to polynomial algebras and descent from the complete local case

proof.text: Write S as a quotient of a polynomial algebra over R, reduce the G-ring assertion to regularity of the completion map at a prime of S, and localize at its contraction to R.

Base change the regular completion map of the localized G-ring, apply the complete-local polynomial formal-fibre theorem, compose regular maps, and descend regularity along the faithfully flat map of completions.

source.place: Proposition 07PV proof, complete-local and descent paragraphs
